motion: This house believes cross-scale shape-matching is a method of discovery, not an engine of apophenia.
referee_tally: TALLY: Proposition: 4 kept, 1 struck. Opposition: 5 kept, 0 struck. The single strike fell on Proposition's appeal to a historical above-chance corroboration rate, whose only stated test was a registry the Proposition itself conceded is unrecoverable; the asymmetry records one over-reach, not a ruling on the Motion. Notably, Proposition's surviving engine-claim (turn 3) abandoned the census route and relocated the above-chance condition to an a-priori claim about filter selectivity — which is the same ground Opposition's uncomputability claim stakes out — so the two sides' strongest surviving claims now meet on one field rather than passing each other.
